rule: Sam, 2026-11-17, relayed by COBIx on #3358 section 2: collect with gaps noted and confidence scores; Commons Clarity's Part B (#3480, comment 6967374303); COBIx's D2 decision (major total differs, about 30); Sam's routine prompt of 2026-11-25, as the S739 conductor's brief carries it: a record held for a gap is collected with its gap named and a lower score on the 0-100 bar, never held, unless the record is not the program's own; S739: Contra Costa's records kb/receipts/program_requirement_records_piles_s740_contra_costa_2026-11-26_s740g.json held, read again by key: passed by a rescore where today's scorer's one reading moves them, else collected with their gaps named where the record is the program's own (no reread, no reconcile)

gaps.degree_summary_ge_none: The page's unit summary prints the degree total and prints its general education and electives as None or N/A, so the record holds the major alone; the major adds up to its printed major total.
gaps.noted_unit_floor: The catalog requires a variable-unit course at a minimum above the units printed beside it; with that minimum the courses add to the printed total.

held.why: held: its notes print general education as None and N/A and say nothing of its electives, so degree_summary_ge_none's sentence (general education and electives as None or N/A) is not its own (the second reader, S720), and no other kind's sentence is true of it. Page read 45955333186 printed the page's shell and course rows and not its Unit Summary, so the electives row is still unread: a page read that prints the summary, then degree_summary_ge_none

records.words: degree_total 60 is taken from the unit summary 'Min/Max Units - Total Program 60 / 60'. The summary lists Local GE as 'None', CSU/IGETC GE as 'N/A' and electives as 'None', which does not reconcile with 37 major units and 60 total; the description mentions 'breadth requirements' without naming a GE pattern. Reviewer should check.
records.read_against: today's arithmetic (the filed one is an older scorer's and stays as filed)

program.section_heading: Automotive Collision Repair Technology - A.S. Degree

records.award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units
records.words: CIS099 (Occupational Work Experience, 1-4 units) is matched to closed-list CIS 99 (Work Experience); the description says the program requires 2 units of occupational work experience, which reconciles the course units (4+4+2+4+3+3+2) with the stated 22-unit total.

before_image.award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

representation: checks.gaps and checks.confidence added as the load reads the filed score (a passing row: checks.arithmetic to equal); checks.coverage, invented and the record unchanged
claim_check_reads: Today's capture (sources.json): every course an entry names among the codes it found, and a course an entry says the printed total leaves out on neither it nor the state's list. A note's quoted figures are the reader's words, never re-read here.
follow_verdict: The follow_verdict trigger marks a row checked when its latest verdict is a confirm whose fingerprint matches the record and the machine checks pass. The record is unchanged here, so such a confirm on a row this plan moves to passing would check it at the apply, and the rollback would skip it. The pre-read counts those rows (confirm_matches); the apply aborts, writing nothing, unless the count is 0.
